questions.question: Which element of art describes a mark that moves through space?
What does shape describe?
choices: The surface feel of an object

questions.question: How does form differ from shape?
choices: Form is always abstract; shape is always realistic
Form describes color; shape describes value
Form has three-dimensional volume; shape is two-dimensional

questions.question: What is value in art?
choices: The lightness or darkness of a color

questions.question: What does texture describe in a visual artwork?
choices: The actual or suggested surface quality

questions.question: What is space in an artwork?
choices: The area around, between, or within forms

questions.question: What is hue?
choices: The amount of light in a room
The name of a color, such as red or blue

questions.question: How can overlapping forms suggest depth?
choices: The overlapping form appears closer than the one it covers

questions.question: Which element can make a flat circle appear spherical?
A drawing uses repeated diagonal lines. Which element is most evident?
What is implied texture?
choices: A color that has been mixed
A visual suggestion of how a surface might feel

questions.question: How can negative space help a composition?
choices: It clarifies shapes and relationships by giving forms room

questions.question: What is a geometric shape?
choices: A shape based on precise forms such as circles or rectangles
A shape found only in nature

questions.question: Which example best shows organic shape?
Why might an artist vary line weight?
choices: To make every area equally important
To create emphasis, depth, or visual movement

questions.question: What does a highlight usually indicate in a modeled form?
choices: A cast shadow on the floor

questions.question: How can texture contribute to meaning?
choices: Surface qualities can suggest material, mood, or sensory experience

questions.question: What is the difference between actual and implied texture?
choices: Actual texture is always smooth; implied is rough
Actual texture can be physically felt; implied texture is visually represented
Actual is color; implied is line

questions.question: A still life has objects that seem to float. Which element may need clearer development?
Why do artists study elements of art?
choices: They provide vocabulary for making and analyzing visual choices
